groups.description: Triggers an action, or joins related buttons into one row or column.
Toggles a state, or joins related toggles into a group.
Show how much of a task is complete, or a measured value within a range.
Accept a date or time, with one editable segment for each part of the value.
Show a month grid to select one date or a start and end date, with limits.
Accept a date or range that you type or select from a calendar popover.
Accept, show, and select colors with a field, swatch, or picker in a popover.
Group fields, handle validation and submission, and label native controls.
Select one or more options from a list or grid that stays visible on the page.
Reveal an agent's tool calls and reasoning, with their input, output, and duration.
Animate text changes with a swap, reveal, scramble, or counted number.
Animate content in when it appears and out before it unmounts, including list items.
Show a loading indicator for a wait, or a placeholder shape while content loads.
Show data in rows and columns, with search, filters, sorting, and selection.
